t: You're in Max Roach Park, a public park in Brixton, in the London Borough of Lambeth. It takes its name from the American jazz drummer Max Roach, who visited the park in 1986. Roach was a pioneer of bebop and is generally considered one of the most important drummers in history. He played with giants of jazz, including Charlie Parker, Dizzy Gillespie, Miles Davis, Duke Ellington and Thelonious Monk. So a green space in south London carries the name of a musician who shaped the sound of modern jazz.
